claims.summary: Partition kernels in every field: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) over any field, with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for partition errors E_{A_i} = sum_{j in A_i} x_1j + sum_{j not in A_i} x_2j, i = 1..r, and J the intersection of the Ann_C(E_{A_i}) cap V_K: (a) for a choice of representatives R_i = E_{A_i} + Q_2 (edges in A_i) or E_{A_i} + Q_1 (edges in A_i^c) whose edge union leaves at least rho holes, J is W plus the u in V_K vanishing at every partial matching outside the intersection of the zero sets of the R_i; outside characteristic 2 these are {pigeon 2 in A, pigeon 1 not in A} and {pigeon 1 in A^c, pigeon 2 not in A^c}, in characteristic 2 the sets where exactly one of pigeons 1, 2 is matched to a hole of A, respectively of A^c; (b) for a pair the four choices leave N - |A cup B|, |A cap B|, |B minus A| and |A minus B| holes; (c) in characteristic 2, E_A + E_B = S_{A sym-diff B} with S_T = sum_{j in T}(x_1j + x_2j), so J = Ann_C(E_A) cap Ann_C(S_{A sym-diff B}) cap V_K for every pair and every K; (d) from K >= 2, for holes h != j, x_1h x_2j E_A = ([h in A] + [j not in A]) x_1h x_2j modulo H, so x_1h x_2j is a common surviving killer of E_{A_1}..E_{A_r} exactly when every A_i separates h and j in characteristic 2, and exactly when j lies in every A_i and h in none otherwise; in characteristic 2 every pair of nonempty proper sets has such a killer.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two passes with corrections; part (d), the classification of the monomial killers, is the reviewer's suggestion, its proof written out and checked in the second pass.
claims.rationale: The general version, in every field, of the common kernel of partition errors in the proper closure where a choice of representatives has room, with the characteristic-2 zero sets and a classification of the surviving monomial killers x_1h x_2j in every field.
claims.next_action: A disjoint pair in characteristic 3 without room, at seven pigeons and six holes.
